user.title: WristTalk
user.description: Voice assistant for Home Assistant on a Garmin watch.

data_description.pipeline: The Assist pipeline a new watch uses; each watch can pick its own in its device card.
data_description.url: The watch reaches Home Assistant through the phone, which needs HTTPS with a trusted certificate (e.g. Home Assistant Cloud). Plain http:// does not work, also at home.

error.https_required: The address must start with https://

data_description.url: A changed address must reach the watches: paste it in the WristTalk settings in Garmin Connect, or pair the watch again.
